feature: HM-516 — Profile Page authored posts and uploaded media

scenarios.title: Posts tab loads with authored posts in reverse chronological order
scenarios.preconditions: User is authenticated and has authored posts
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on their Profile Page
When the page loads
Then the Posts tab is selected by default
And authored posts are displayed in reverse chronological order
And each post card shows title, created date, status, and engagement stats
scenarios.expected_result: The authenticated user's authored posts appear in the Posts tab sorted newest first

scenarios.title: Media tab shows uploaded media thumbnails and metadata
scenarios.preconditions: User is authenticated and has uploaded media assets
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on their Profile Page
When the user clicks the Media tab
Then the uploaded media gallery is visible
And each media item displays a thumbnail and upload date
scenarios.expected_result: The Media tab presents the user's uploaded media with visible thumbnails and metadata

scenarios.title: Empty authored posts state shows clear no-posts message
scenarios.preconditions: User is authenticated and has no authored posts
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on their Profile Page
When the page loads
Then the Posts tab displays "You haven’t posted yet."
And the post list area remains empty
scenarios.expected_result: The Posts tab shows a helpful empty state and no authored posts are rendered

scenarios.title: Empty media state shows no-uploaded-media message
scenarios.preconditions: User is authenticated and has no uploaded media
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on their Profile Page
When the user clicks the Media tab
Then the Media tab displays "You haven’t uploaded any media yet."
And no media thumbnails are rendered
scenarios.expected_result: The Media tab shows an empty state with no media items

scenarios.title: Unauthorized user is redirected from Profile Page to login
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is not logged in
When the user navigates to /profile
Then the user is redirected to the login page
And an authentication message is shown
scenarios.expected_result: Unauthenticated access to Profile Page is blocked and login is required

scenarios.title: Clicking a post opens detail and returns to same scroll position
scenarios.preconditions: User has at least three authored posts on the Posts tab
scenarios.steps:
Given the user has scrolled to post #3
When the user clicks the third post card
Then the post detail page opens
And when the user navigates back the Posts tab restores scroll position to post #3
scenarios.expected_result: The user returns to the same authored post position after viewing details

scenarios.title: Media lightbox opens when clicking a thumbnail
scenarios.preconditions: User is on the Media tab with at least one media item
scenarios.steps:
Given the Media tab is active
When the user clicks a media thumbnail
Then a lightbox opens showing the full media asset
And closing the lightbox returns to the Media tab
scenarios.expected_result: Media preview opens in a lightbox and the user returns to the Media tab cleanly
edge_cases: Lightbox open fails for non-image media

scenarios.title: Media filenames containing emoji render without layout break
scenarios.preconditions: User has uploaded media with emoji in filenames
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on the Media tab
When the media grid renders
Then filenames with emoji display correctly
And thumbnails remain aligned without layout break
scenarios.expected_result: Emoji filenames are displayed safely and the media grid remains intact

scenarios.title: Keyboard navigation reaches Posts tab, Media tab, and post cards sequentially
scenarios.preconditions: User is on their Profile Page
scenarios.steps:
Given the Profile Page is focused
When the user presses Tab repeatedly
Then focus moves to the Posts tab, Media tab, and visible post cards in order
And pressing Enter activates the focused tab or post
scenarios.expected_result: Keyboard users can navigate Profile Page tabs and post cards without a mouse

scenarios.title: Responsive mobile layout stacks Posts and Media tabs vertically
scenarios.preconditions: User opens Profile Page on a 375px-wide viewport
scenarios.steps:
Given the Profile Page is opened on mobile viewport
When the page renders
Then the Posts and Media tabs stack vertically
And thumbnails and cards remain fully visible
scenarios.expected_result: The Profile Page adapts to mobile view and content remains readable

scenarios.title: Post preview text truncates at 200 characters with Read more link
scenarios.preconditions: User has an authored post with more than 200 characters
scenarios.steps:
Given the Posts tab is active
When the long post is rendered
Then the preview text truncates to 200 characters
And a Read more link is visible
scenarios.expected_result: Long authored post text is trimmed in the preview and expandable on demand

scenarios.title: Author ownership is limited to current user's authored posts only
scenarios.preconditions: Another user has public posts in the system
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on their Profile Page
When the Posts tab loads
Then only posts authored by the current user are shown
And no other user's authored posts appear
scenarios.expected_result: The Profile Page displays only the authenticated user's authored content

scenarios.title: Profile Page post count matches rendered authored posts
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on their Profile Page
When the Posts tab loads
Then the displayed authored posts count equals the number of rendered post cards
scenarios.expected_result: The authored post count displayed on Profile Page is accurate

scenarios.title: Media tab handles non-image uploads with placeholder and download link
scenarios.preconditions: User uploads a PDF as media
scenarios.steps:
Given the Media tab is active
When the non-image media item is displayed
Then a placeholder icon appears
And a download link is available
scenarios.expected_result: Non-image uploaded media is displayed safely with a download option

scenarios.title: Profile Page retains selected tab after page refresh
scenarios.preconditions: User has the Media tab selected
scenarios.steps:
Given the Media tab is active
When the page is refreshed
Then the Media tab remains active
And the same media content is shown
scenarios.expected_result: Tab state is preserved across refreshes for the Profile Page

scenarios.title: Session expiration on Profile Page prompts login and preserves return location
scenarios.preconditions: User is authenticated and session expires while on Profile Page
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on their Profile Page
When the session expires
Then the user is redirected to login
And after login the user is returned to the Profile Page
scenarios.expected_result: Expired session on Profile Page forces re-authentication and restores user context

coverage_summary: Covers Profile Page authored posts display, uploaded media viewing, empty states, access control, navigation behavior, keyboard accessibility, and edge cases for emoji and non-image media.
assumptions: HM-516 is focused on profile content display rather than export
Posts and Media are separate tabbed sections
